Reiko Yanagi (Provisional License).name: Reiko Yanagi (Provisional License)
Reiko Yanagi (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Reiko Yanagi, hero name Emily, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with all of 1-B, at a different venue from 1-A, and now holds a provisional license. Very pale skin, silver hair over one eye; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Soft, sparse, flat, faintly eerie.
Combat Role: Mid-range support drilled for blocking, distraction and clearing debris in rescues.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and keeps to 1-B's roles.
Reiko Yanagi (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A hero is meant to reassure the public, and her manner unsettles people before her Quirk helps them. Motivation: Be a hero people are glad to see, ghost look and all. Connections: Yui Kodai, still the classmate whose Quirk fits hers best. Knowledge: Knows the license lets her act in an emergency and does not make her a pro. Thread: Whether the public learns to trust the ghost in the crowd.
QUIRK: Poltergeist. Practiced and exact; same weight limit.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; holds a provisional license.
personality: Ghostly manner: Drifts quietly through the dorm, unsettling without trying.
Attentive teammate: Drills her rescue and capture role until it is automatic.
Precise: Moves exactly the object that matters, faster than in spring.
Speaking style: Soft, sparse, flat, faintly eerie; her look is never played as real haunting.
abilities: Poltergeist: Moves nearby objects without touch, up to about a person's weight.
Rescue support: Lifts debris off a casualty or out of a rescuer's path.
Distraction: Sends several objects on separate paths to split a rival's attention.
Provisional license: May use her Quirk in an emergency; it does not make her a pro.
Fighting style: Stays at mid-range behind floating objects and sets up a teammate's capture.
Reiko Yanagi (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with very pale skin, short silver hair with a long fringe that hides one eye, half-lidded dark blue eyes and a slight build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Deadpan expression with the faintest smile.
